overviews.title: What is Information Design?: Course Fees 2026, Subjects, Top Colleges, Admissions

blocks.value: Information Design is all about presenting information to the audience in a visually appealing and easy-to-understand manner , making it more accessible, cohesive, and functional. Information Design is considered a subset of Graphic Design, which focuses specifically on the effective display of information. A few examples include warning signboards, how-to guides, wayfinding systems, etc.

Information Design Syllabus includes subjects like typography, data visualization, layout, color theory, and user-centered design which is also known as UCD. The Information Design Courses also teaches the students to use tools like Adobe , Tableau , or Canva to create accessible, engaging, and story-driven graphics for diverse audiences , bridging communication theory with practical design and data analysis.

After completing the course, Information Design Graduates can find jobs in Consulting, Advertising & Marketing Agencies, Technology, Publishing & Media, E-commerce & FinTech Industries in various roles which can be UX/UI Designer, Information Architect (IA), Graphic Designer, Data Visualization Designer in top companies such as Google , Deloitte , Microsoft, etc.
Students who are interested in pursuing Information Design Courses can read the article further.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for pursuing BDes Information Design course?
faqs.answer: You can study BDes in Information Design after passing Class 12 in any background - Science, Arts, or Commerce, and having at least 50 to 60% marks in the board exams. Plus, you also need to appear for relevant Design entrance exams and get excellent marks and rank in the same to grab a seat at top design institutes. Rest; it is always better to go to the official college websites where you're planning to apply and check for the eligibility requirements to have better clarity.

faqs.question: What is the general admission process for BDes Information Design course?
faqs.answer: You should start with the first and the most important step of checking the eligibility criteria for BDes Information Design that is set by different colleges. Then, you need to take the relevant entrance exams and get excellent marks and a high rank if you want to get a seat at top colleges. You also need to fill the college application forms before the last date for a smooth admission process. After the exam results are out and you've got your marks, you may have to appear for skill-based tests or submit a strong portfolio to show your skills. Also, you must take part in the counseling rounds that are made for seat allotment based on your performance in the written test and other admission rounds. After getting a seat, you need to get your documents verified by visiting the college and pay the BDes Information Design course fees after which you can start attending classes. Good Luck!

faqs.question: Is the Information Design syllabus the same for all colleges?
faqs.answer: Not at all. The Information Design course syllabus is not the same for all colleges, rather differs on the basis of the course level and the college where you're planning to study the course. Each Information Design college has its own syllabus guidelines to provide the students with the best learning resources possible, which is a mix of core subjects, professional electives, projects, lab classes, workshop sessions, internships, etc. A few core concepts might be similar, but the electives are different. Hope this helps!!!

salary.title: Information Design: Salary, Career Scope, Job Profiles & Top Recruiters

blocks.value: The Information Design Graduates are in demand nowadays because of the continuously advancing digital landscape and the decreasing attention span of the audience have resulted in a drastic shift towards visual storytelling and interactive content. Top tech and product companies are looking for talented information designers to create visually appealing dashboards for their websites that attract users while the marketing, media and journalism industries are after engaging infographics and visual narratives to help audiences connect with and retain information.
Interested candidates can check the table below to find Information Design jobs along with the Information Design salary :

value: Produces visual content to convey messages or create aesthetic effects using various media, including digital illustration, photo editing software, and layout tools.
Develops user-friendly interfaces for digital products such as websites and apps, focusing on design, functionality, usability, marketing, and branding.
Tasked with designing and managing an organization’s data infrastructure, ensuring the accuracy, security, and accessibility of data.
Collaborate with data to create engaging content, including visual aids, charts, graphs, animations, and slideshows.

Creates visual content, such as logos, websites, and marketing campaigns, to effectively convey messages. Utilizing tools like the Adobe Suite, they develop engaging and strategic designs that persuade audiences and strengthen brand identity.

blocks.value: At the UG level , you have the option for a BDes in Information Design degree , which takes around 4 years to complete, and at the PG level, you can go for an MDes in Information Design, where you need to invest at least 2 years . If you're looking for short-term and more affordable course options, you have the option of diploma or certificate Information Design courses online which do not take more than a few months to 1 year to complete.
